desc: A primitive KNIFE with a leaf-shaped blade of knapped dark FLINT and a handle of pale bone wrapped in leather, propped up at an angle on a small flat stone. an ancient sacred relic of the first ten humans, small, weathered and very old, seen from the high three-quarter top-down game camera, standing upright on its own (no stand, no table, no ground) as it would sit on a small offering tray.
